evidence.quote: In this interview, we uncover Tomas's journey, how he mastered app development with Lovable.dev, and the lessons he learned while creating Dummy Forms and other successful projects.
Dummy Forms was particularly rewarding because it won third place in a Lovable hackathon and ranked fifth on Product Hunt with minimal promotion.

notes.zh: 构建者 Tomas Henkenhaf 在 Lovable 官方博客访谈（2025-01-22）中点名用 Lovable.dev 创建 DummyForms，并称获 Lovable 黑客松第三名（目录仅称 won hackathon，名次以访谈为准）。原址公开 200、无付费墙；表单服务为账号制，含 Free 档与 Craft $12/月付费档，数据去向未核。站点 meta 作者署名 Vyomesh Tala，与访谈构建者不一致，归属细节未核。许可不明，仅外链、不镜像。
notes.en: Builder Tomas Henkenhaf names Lovable.dev as the tool used to create DummyForms in a Lovable blog interview (2025-01-22), where he says it won third place in a Lovable hackathon (the directory only said 'won'; the interview gives the placing). Origin checked 2026-11-07: HTTP 200, no paywall; the form service is account-based with a free tier and a US$12/month Craft plan, data handling unverified. The site's meta author credits Vyomesh Tala, differing from the interview's builder; ownership details unverified. Licence unclear; link-only, no mirroring.
